Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 2007
ACT I OF 2007
SINDH FINANCE ACT,
2007
An Act to rationalize
certain taxes in the Province
of Sindh and to amend
relevant laws
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
26th July, 2007]
No.PAS/Legis-B-5/2007,
dated 26-7-2007.---The Sindh Finance Bill, 2007 have
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 27th June, 2007 and assented to by
the Governor of Sindh on 26th July, 2007, is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to rationalize certain taxes in
the Province of Sindh and to
amend relevant laws in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh
Finance Act, 2007.
(2) It shall come into force on and from
1st day of July, 2007.

3. Amendment of section 8 of Sindh Act VII of 1977.---In the Sindh
Finance Act, 1977, in section 8, for subsection (1), the following shall be
substituted:-
"(1) There shall be levied a tax on
hotels to be called the hotel tax on ad valorem basis
at the rate of seven and half per cent of room rent per lodging unit per day at
a flat rate of eighty per cent of the total number of lodging units."
